Interface ExchangeSupport

All Superinterfaces:
EnvInfoProvider, FundingRateSource, KlineProvider, KlineSource, Named, QTSTradeServiceProvider, Supplier<QTSTradeService>, TickerProvider, TickerSource
public interface ExchangeSupport extends Named, TickerProvider, KlineProvider, FundingRateSource, QTSTradeServiceProvider, EnvInfoProvider
Exchange support hub interface. Aggregates the exchange-related provider interfaces that speak the engine's own model.

Everything here is engine-typed, so strategies, the execution layer and the runtime can consume an exchange without naming a connector library's types. The connector-typed surface lives behind getConnector(), which only a live exchange adapter provides.

    • getConnector

      default Optional<ExchangeConnector> getConnector()
      The connector-level surface of this exchange, empty when there is none.

      Empty means offline: a backtest support has no exchange to ask for a trade service, an order book or an account balance, and used to answer those calls with nulls and never-completing observables that a caller simply had to know not to trust. An empty optional says the same thing in a way a caller cannot accidentally use.

      Returns:
      the connector surface, or empty when this support is not backed by a live exchange

    • getInstrumentPrecision

      default InstrumentPrecision getInstrumentPrecision(Instrument instrument)
      Returns the precision (scale / step-size) metadata for a canonical engine instrument. Converts to the connector's instrument at the boundary and wraps the result.
      Parameters:
      instrument - the engine-canonical instrument
      Returns:
      an InstrumentPrecision wrapping the exchange metadata, or one wrapping nothing when there is no connector or the exchange has no metadata for the instrument
